newsitem.title: USA: TENNIS-STEVEN SHOCKS WOODFORDE IN HALL OF FAME QUARTERS.
newsitem.headline: TENNIS-STEVEN SHOCKS WOODFORDE IN HALL OF FAME QUARTERS.

text.p: Eighth seed Brett Steven of New Zealand recorded the first "double bagel" on the ATP Tour this year, crushing second seed Mark Woodforde of Australia 6-0 6-0 Friday to reach the semifinals of the $255,000 Hall of Fame Tennis Championships.
The 28-year-old Steven, ranked 90th in the world, needed just 54 minutes to dispose of Woodforde and earn the first whitewashing since Greg Rusedski swept past Carston Arriens last year in Sydney.
Steven will take on third seed Grant Stafford of South Africa, who rallied past unseeded American David Wheaton 4-6 6-3 6-2.
In the other semifinal matchup, which was set on Thursday, fifth seed Sargis Sargsian of Armenia will battle seventh seed Leander Paes of India.
